entities.summary: Adam Grandmaison, more commonly known as Adam22, is an American podcaster and YouTuber. He is the creator and host of the hip-hop culture-oriented podcast No Jumper. In 2017, Rolling Stone described him as "underground hip-hop's major tastemaker".
